import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
w=Path.cwd()
base=Path('/tmp/localization-zoo-inten-geometric-prior-20261023/publication_final_discovery')
s=Path('/tmp/localization-zoo-imu-dr-retrieval-verification-20261024')
out=w/'experiments/results/imu_dr_readme_and_retrieval/publication'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
shutil.copytree(base,s,symlinks=True)
names=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','origin/main','HEAD'],text=True).splitlines()
overlay={}
for name in names:
 source=w/name
 target=s/name
 if not source.is_file():raise ValueError('expected an added/modified file: '+name)
 parent=s
 for part in Path(name).parent.parts:
  parent=parent/part
  if parent.is_symlink():
   original=parent.resolve();parent.unlink();shutil.copytree(original,parent,symlinks=True)
 assert target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(s.resolve())
 target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 if target.is_symlink():target.unlink()
 shutil.copy2(source,target)
 overlay[name]=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(out/'overlay_sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(overlay,indent=2)+'\n')
commands=[
 ['evaluation/scripts/refresh_study_docs.py'],
 ['evaluation/scripts/generate_full_variant_table.py'],
 ['evaluation/scripts/generate_paper_ratio_table.py'],
 ['evaluation/scripts/validate_showcase.py'],
 ['evaluation/scripts/generate_leaderboard.py','--check'],
 ['evaluation/scripts/generate_paper_ready_evidence.py','--check'],
 ['papers/attitude_estimation/evaluation/broad_benchmark.py','check'],
 ['papers/allan_variance/evaluation/tumvi_allan.py','check'],
 ['-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_official_kiss_matcher.py'],
 ['-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_broad_benchmark.py'],
 ['-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_tumvi_allan.py'],
 ['-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_full_variant_table.py']]
rows=[]
for i,args in enumerate(commands):
 result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,*args],cwd=s,capture_output=True,text=True)
 (out/f'{i:02d}.stdout').write_text(result.stdout)
 (out/f'{i:02d}.stderr').write_text(result.stderr)
 rows.append({'argv':[sys.executable,*args],'cwd':str(s),'exit_code':result.returncode})
 (out/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(args,result.returncode,flush=True)
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
tables={name:sha(s/'docs/assets/paper'/name)==sha(w/'docs/assets/paper'/name) for name in ['full_variant_results.csv','full_variant_results.tex','paper_ratio_table.csv','paper_ratio_table.tex']}
summary={'all_commands_passed':all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in rows),'historical_tables_byte_equal':tables,'readme_leaderboard_not_regenerated':sha(s/'README.md')==sha(w/'README.md')}
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
assert summary['all_commands_passed'] and all(tables.values()) and summary['readme_leaderboard_not_regenerated']
